static_traits.name: Li Wen
static_traits.family_status: Father is a missionary; husband is a US Army soldier; first pregnancy
static_traits.social_status: Living in the countryside, fewer offline social opportunities; Good relationship with husband but he is often out on duty, difficulty making friends in the community
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, able to describe automatic thoughts and worries; steady tone, Positive attitude; able to identify extreme (black-and-white) thinking tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: I feel isolated and believe I lack interpersonal skills, leading to Loneliness and inferiority. After moving to a countryside house following marriage, this Sense of isolation began to appear, further intensifying after pregnancy; I worry about raising the child alone lacking communication skills. This feeling occurs almost daily, especially when my husband is out on duty.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I realize that feelings of isolation and inferiority are affecting my mental health and may affect my ability to care for my newborn.
growth_experiences: After moving to a countryside house following marriage, offline socializing significantly decreased; perceiving declining interpersonal ability, Loneliness and inferiority gradually worsened, further Reinforced after pregnancy; feeling Loneliness and Anxiety daily especially when husband is out on duty, worrying about lacking communication and task-handling ability when raising the child alone.
Original family background: Father is a missionary (specific influence Not mentioned).

special_situations.event: Husband away on duty; oneself alone in the house in the countryside
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no stable companionship and support, I will be unable to handle daily and parenting tasks
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing expressions of Loneliness and Self-doubt to husband, trying to bear emotions alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: There is nobody to turn to, I will always be very Loneliness

special_situations.event: Thinking about soon being alone with the newborn
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my social and communication skills are inadequate, I will become an incompetent Mother
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Magnifying risks in advance, constantly self-checking and worrying to try to 'be well prepared'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will handle everything poorly, I am not a good Mother

special_situations.event: Still feels disconnected after joining an online forum
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If online interaction does not immediately bring a sense of acceptance, it shows I fundamentally have no interpersonal ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further reducing offline attempts, focusing attention on clues that prove 'I am incapable'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Even online I am very unsociable, I truly have no social skills

special_situations.event: Moving to the countryside, facing an environment of Reduced offline socializing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I live in the countryside and still cannot make friends, the reason can only be that I am incapable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Directly binds housing choice to own ability and keeps blaming oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The reason I live alone in the countryside is that I have no interpersonal skills

core_conflict.wish: Longing for companionship, understanding, and support (especially at the stage of impending pregnancy and parenting)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being ignored after expressing dependence or vulnerability, being judged as incapable, or burdening the other
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being rejected or blamed by expressing less and Self-denial
Maintains a certain emotional distance to gain a sense of security

object_relations.self_representation: A Loneliness expectant mother who is not good enough, a person lacking social skills
object_relations.object_representation: Significant others (husband/people around) are busy and find it hard to provide timely responses and support

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about whether to express one's Loneliness and Self-doubt to husband
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing expressing needs will trouble husband, being seen as weak or incapable (holding negative Anticipation of others' reactions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying emotions, avoiding directly stating needs, using a tactful tone and shortening the length of self-disclosure.

manifestations: Reduced offline socializing after moving to the countryside, feeling isolated
Husband often out on duty, long periods of Being alone
Worrying about raising the child alone after pregnancy, without support and communication
outcomes: Self-denial and feelings of not being good enough
Social avoidance and hesitation in action

contact_model.definition: The individual has maladaptive self-Reflection and self-reproach, excessive self-limitation, being overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Equating imperfection with failure ('if I cannot make friends immediately, it shows I never will')
Frequently labeling oneself ('I have no social skills')
Reducing expression of needs due to worry about being judged as incapable

contact_model.definition: Turning energy that should be directed outward against the self, Repressing the urge to express to or seek help from others.
manifestations: Unwilling to express Loneliness and Self-doubt to husband, choosing to bear it alone
Reduces face-to-face help-seeking or exploring offline support channels

positive_force: Relatively stable relationship with the husband
Actively seeks help and starts psychological counseling, positive attitude
Has tried seeking support and connection through online forums
negative_force: Living in the countryside leading to Reduced offline socializing
Self-denial and catastrophic/predicting-the-future thinking worsening Anxiety
Unwilling to express Loneliness and Self-doubt to husband, reducing opportunities to receive support
Worries about caring for the baby alone reinforcing powerlessness and incompetence

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding offline socializing and repeatedly Self-denial ('I have no social skills'), accompanied by Loneliness and Anxiety
antecedent: Being alone when husband is out on duty
Thinking about soon caring for the newborn alone
Lives in a rural environment with few offline social opportunities
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative core beliefs about one's own social ability and catastrophic/predicting-the-future automatic thoughts (worrying about becoming an incompetent Mother, unable to communicate and cope)
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential being rejected/judgment and failure, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent Loneliness and Anxiety, Daily self-care affected, social skills and support networks hard to build
